strategies.name: premarket_level_breakout_or_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST to the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart. Enter in the direction of the move only after price cleanly breaks above the high or below the low and either (a) closes beyond the level with elevated volume, or (b) pulls back to retest the broken pre-
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry/breakout candle or just below/above the retest entry candle. Initial profit objective is at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and trail the stop to breakeven or into profit until stopped out or satisfied.

strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: When price briefly breaks above the pre-market high or below the pre-market low but then fails and reclaims the level, enter in the opposite direction of the failed break. The reclaim/failure of the level is the confirmation, with volume helping validate the sweep.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry candle. Look for at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and move the stop to breakeven or into profit, letting the trade continue until stopped out or profit is sufficient.
